title: Map your understanding and build lessons from the gaps
surface: Claude.ai chat (with optional Claude Desktop/Cowork and Claude in Excel for follow-up work)
description: Claude Opus 4.6 traces your confusion to its source. It maps what you already understand, finds the specific misconception underneath, and builds personalized learning experiences around it.
prompt: I keep running into 'Bayesian reasoning' in things I read—essays, podcasts, even conversations at work. People say 'update your priors' or 'you're ignoring the base rate' and I nod along, but I can't actually follow the logic when it gets specific. I understand basic probability fine. I can calculate odds, I know what a conditional probability is in the abstract. But when someone explains why a 99% accurate test doesn't mean a 99% chance you're sick, I lose the thread halfway through. Help me understand this. Then build me an interactive lesson, a workbook I can use to audit which signals in my hiring pipeline actually predict success, and a concept map connecting it to what I'll encounter next.
prerequisites: CSV or XLSX export of screening/pipeline data (optional, for personalized workbook)
